maintenance_led.reason: Sells orthobiologic grafts and spinal implants used in new surgical procedures, not repair or servicing of installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Surgical biologics and spinal implants sold to hospitals and surgeons, paid mainly by commercial insurers, private payers and Medicare mix.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling its own biologics and spinal implants; past acquisitions (Bacterin, X-spine) were occasional, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Surgeons can switch graft and implant suppliers; spinal implant systems carry some instrument training, but biologics are fairly substitutable.

notes: Payer mix for hospitals is mixed; public share not stated on the website.
